_comment: Pins capitalAvoided() and stack() across every candidate. Re-cut for the new/used market dimension: capitalAvoided() now prices in a market, defaulting to 'used' on sites whose generation is SHUTDOWN and to 'new' everywhere else. 462 sites of 11,829 moved (3.9%); FULL BUILD -0.82% and STILL TO SPEND -0.81% across the catalogue. The default is deliberately narrow — including 'present' equipment would have fired on 10,682 sites (90.3%) and dropped the aggregate build 40.1%, because at a running plant you inherit equipment rather than buying it and the condition discount already prices that.
_independence: Market and condition are independent multipliers: avoided = full(market) x discount(age). The used/new avoided ratio is asserted identical at four shutdown ages, and every component's discount is asserted equal across markets, because the avoided column moves on both axes and that is where an interaction would hide.
generated_from: market dimension, on top of d1d8960 (shutdown unification), 61fc2d4 (rate basis), e3d4cff (civil rate)
verified: both digests recomputed from the test's own serialisation; sensitivity re-confirmed by nudging a rate
